items.html: Now, AVI, in whom there was nullification but not actual death, as there was in ZON, as above, also had within them the phases of male and female, each in its own right. That is, in the phase of two Partzufim like ZON. But they had an additional, immense bond: they are attached together face to face at all times, with only a single wall serving them both, and there is no separation at all between them — unlike ZON, who are joined when back to back, and separate when face to face.
